# Programs Two open seasonal internships (Brand Marketing, Social Media Video). No named intern class or summer program


*Last updated: November 2026*


The Detroit Red Wings have two student-level internships open right now, and neither names a deadline. On 17 October 2026 the team's TeamWork Online board listed a Brand Marketing Seasonal Assistant and a Social Media Seasonal Video Editor for the 2026-27 hockey season, both tagged Intern and both posted by Ilitch Sports + Entertainment, the company that employs the team's business staff. These are season-long roles, not summer ones, and we found no Red Wings summer program. Here's the cycle in plain words: you apply this fall for the season already under way, and the next round is expected around September to October 2027, a projection from a single cycle. Check your class year first: the Brand Marketing role asks for a college senior or recent graduate, and the Video Editor role takes a college student or recent graduate.


---


## What Is a Detroit Red Wings Internship?


A Detroit Red Wings internship is a seasonal role with the NHL team's business side at Little Caesars Arena in Detroit. The legal employer on the postings is Ilitch Sports + Entertainment, shown as Olympia Entertainment Inc., which also runs the Detroit Tigers, Little Caesars Arena and the Fox Theatre. The Red Wings post these roles as "Seasonal" assistants and tag them Intern on[TeamWork Online](https://www.teamworkonline.com/multiple-properties/ilitch-sports/detroit-red-wings) . On 17 October 2026 there were two: Brand Marketing, which covers game-day activations, fan-engagement analytics and the Red Wings Kids Club, and Social Media Video Editing, which covers highlights, hype reels and sponsored content. Neither posting gives pay, dates or a deadline. Roles that aren't internships, such as the Red Patrol Entertainment Team (part-time), sit on the same board.


## When Do Detroit Red Wings Internship Applications Open for 2027–2028?


The Red Wings' internships follow the hockey season, not a summer calendar. Both open roles went up in the weeks before 17 October 2026: Ilitch's Workday record for Brand Marketing carries a start date of 28 September 2026, and TeamWork showed the Video Editor role as about a week old. We couldn't recover the previous cycle, because TeamWork removes closed postings and no earlier capture of the Ilitch careers hub exists, so the 2027-28 timing is a projection from this one cycle: expect the next round around September to October 2027.


Now · October 2026 YOU ARE HERE


Two Red Wings internships are open for the 2026-27 season, Brand Marketing and Social Media Video Editing, and neither states a deadline. Apply this week, and turn on TeamWork alerts for new Red Wings postings.


Build proof while you apply: the[Beats by Dre Creative Advertising Strategy Externship](https://www.extern.com/externships/beats-by-dre-creative-advertising-strategy-externship-nov-2026) for brand and activation work, or the[Pinterest Gen Z Consumer Behavior Externship](https://www.extern.com/externships/pinterest-gen-z-consumer-behavior-nov-2026) for short-form audience insight.


October to November 2026


Tailor your application to the role. The Video Editor posting requires a portfolio of social video and strong hockey knowledge; the Brand Marketing posting asks for prior internship or administrative experience and strong writing.


2026-27 hockey season


The roles are tied to the season and include game days, with irregular hours including nights, weekends and holidays. Start and end dates aren't published.


January to August 2027


We found no Red Wings internship posted in this stretch, but TeamWork hides closed postings, so absence isn't proof. Keep your alerts on.


~September to October 2027 EXPECTED


Applications for the 2027-28 season are expected around now, projected from this cycle only. Treat the month as low confidence and check the board each week from August.


*How to read this page: our dates come from tracking previous recruiting cycles and daily posting data. Treat them as informed estimates based on historical patterns, not confirmed dates. The company's official careers page is always the most current source. If a role is posted there, go by that, even if this page suggests the window hasn't opened yet.*


### Why You Must Apply the Week Applications Open


The evidence for urgency is thin but points one way. Neither posting states a deadline. TeamWork removes a role once it closes, so a posting can vanish without notice, and both roles are tied to a season that's already under way. We can't say how long last year's roles stayed up, so don't assume a window exists. Apply this week if you qualify.

## Which Detroit Red Wings Internship Programs Should You Target?


These are the two internships on the Red Wings' board on 17 October 2026. Both are seasonal roles for the 2026-27 hockey season.


Role Focus Location Key skills


Brand Marketing Seasonal Assistant Game-day activations, marketing requests, fan-engagement analytics, Red Wings Kids Club, research on other teams and leagues Detroit Microsoft Office, strong writing, prior internship or administrative experience


Social Media Seasonal Video Editor Social-first video for Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and X: highlights, hype reels, features, sponsored content Detroit Adobe Creative Suite, portfolio, strong knowledge of hockey


Find both on the[Red Wings TeamWork board](https://www.teamworkonline.com/multiple-properties/ilitch-sports/detroit-red-wings) . Brand Marketing is also on Ilitch's Workday site, while the Video Editor role appeared only on TeamWork. Other rows on the board, like the Red Patrol Entertainment Team, are part-time event jobs, not internships.


## What Are the Eligibility Requirements?


Both postings are written for students close to graduating, and neither states a GPA or work-authorization rule:


• **Brand Marketing:** a college senior or recent graduate, with prior internship or administrative experience, Microsoft Office and strong writing.


• **Video Editor:** a college student or recent graduate with a degree in video editing and production or a related field, or equivalent work experience.


• **Hockey and portfolio:** the Video Editor posting asks for above-average knowledge of the game and a strong portfolio of social video work.


• **Hours and conditions:** the Brand Marketing posting lists irregular and extended hours, including nights, weekends and holidays, and lifting up to 25 pounds.


• **Pay, dates and academic credit:** not stated in either posting.


### Do You Need to Be a Senior or Recent Graduate?


For Brand Marketing, the posting says so directly: college senior or recent graduate. The Video Editor posting is wider and says college student or recent graduate, so a junior with strong video work could reasonably apply. Neither posting mentions a GPA. If you're earlier in college, use this year to build the reel or project these roles ask for.

Two postings are too few to chart honestly, so here's what they ask for. **Brand Marketing:** Microsoft Office, writing, internal communications, and analytics to judge fan engagement. **Video Editor:** Adobe Creative Suite, videography, editing, lighting and sound, with motion graphics a plus. Both need game-day availability, plus a feel for how hockey fans behave on social platforms.


> **Note:** We don't show a skills bar chart for the Red Wings: only two internship postings were open on 17 October 2026, and two postings can't support a meaningful frequency. The skills above come from a full read of both postings.

## What Is the Detroit Red Wings Application and Interview Process Like?


The Red Wings don't publish an interview format. This is what the postings show:


1. **Find the role.** Open the Red Wings' TeamWork board and filter by the Intern tag, or watch the Ilitch Workday site for Brand Marketing.


2. **Apply.** Click Apply Now on TeamWork. The postings warn you must fully complete the application on the follow-up screen.


3. **Attach your work.** The Video Editor posting requires a portfolio of social video.


4. **Interview.** Not published; expect questions on the role and your availability for game days.


5. **Offer.** Pay, start date and hours aren't in the postings, so ask for them before you accept.


A Detroit Reddit thread on breaking into local sports gave one consistent tip: keep watching Ilitch listings.

## How Do You Stand Out for a Red Wings Internship?


Three moves. First, apply early and to the role. Both postings are open with no deadline, so a complete application this week beats a perfect one next month. Second, show the exact proof each posting asks for: a social-first video reel and hockey knowledge for the Video Editor, prior internship or administrative experience and clean writing for Brand Marketing. Third, name the real work. The postings mention the Kids Club, concourse activations and content for sponsors, so describe a project you've done that looks like that. The Red Wings don't publish an applicant count or a conversion rate, so treat the internship as your way in and ask about full-time paths once you're there.

## FAQ


### Can I still apply for a summer 2026 Detroit Red Wings internship?


No, and we found no Red Wings summer program at all. The roles found are seasonal, tied to the hockey season. Two are open now for 2026-27: Brand Marketing and Social Media Video Editor, with no deadline stated. The next round is expected around September to October 2027.


### Are any Detroit Red Wings internships open right now?


Yes. On 17 October 2026 the Red Wings' TeamWork board listed two Intern-level roles: Brand Marketing Seasonal Assistant and Social Media Seasonal Video Editor. Neither posting states a deadline, pay or dates, so apply soon and check the board for changes.


### Who hires Detroit Red Wings interns?


Ilitch Sports + Entertainment, shown on the postings as Olympia Entertainment Inc. It also runs the Detroit Tigers, Little Caesars Arena and the Fox Theatre. The Red Wings stay the team you'd work for, but a Tigers posting on the same board is a different team's role.


### Is the Detroit Red Wings internship paid?


The postings don't say. Neither the TeamWork postings nor Ilitch's job page for Brand Marketing states pay, hours or whether academic credit is involved, and we don't use figures from job aggregators. Ask about pay and hours at the interview stage, before you accept.


### Who can apply for a Red Wings internship?


Brand Marketing asks for a college senior or recent graduate. The Video Editor role asks for a college student or recent graduate, with a portfolio and strong hockey knowledge. Neither posting states a GPA or work-authorization requirement, so confirm eligibility in the application.


### When will 2027-28 Detroit Red Wings internships be posted?


Expected around September to October 2027, projected from the current cycle only, so confidence is low. The Red Wings' roles follow the hockey season and TeamWork hides closed postings, so we couldn't recover earlier dates. Turn on TeamWork alerts and check weekly from August.


### Is a Detroit Red Wings internship the same as a Rochester Red Wings internship?


No. The Rochester Red Wings are a minor-league baseball team in New York with their own hiring. The Detroit Red Wings are the NHL club at Little Caesars Arena, and their internships are posted by Ilitch Sports + Entertainment on the Detroit Red Wings TeamWork board.


### Do Red Wings interns get full-time offers?


The Red Wings don't publish a conversion rate or class size. A Detroit sports thread suggests entry-level business jobs often start in ticket sales and that sports pay runs below comparable corporate work. Treat the internship as a foot in the door, not a guaranteed offer.


The Red Wings' two seasonal internships are open now, and the next round is expected around September 2027. Apply to what fits today, and if you want a finished project for your portfolio, a[remote Externship](https://www.extern.com/externships) takes about 5 to 10 hours a week.
